scope_guards: The 192-home proposal is retained once and is not combined with an earlier allocation figure.
One hundred percent Build to Rent is tenure and not additional capacity.
The 16.2 percent affordable component is a subset of 192 and not extra homes.
Notification letters, representations and objections are consultation metrics rather than dwellings.
The committee resolution remained subject to Mayor direction, S106 and conditions.
The 23 March 2026 legal-agreement deadline is not treated as proof of refusal, extension or final grant without a direct official outcome.
Allocation and meeting provenance do not establish exact HMLR title topology or commencement.
No score or promotion is written without current finality, exact geometry, title relation and executed overlays.
